bug: The state block samples reset synchronously instead of asynchronously.
trigger: Assert and deassert reset entirely between rising edges of clk; for example, pulse reset high midway between two rising edges while a delay line contains nonzero data.
effect: The pulse is missed, so outputs and filter history are not cleared and can affect subsequent normal traffic.

edits.old: always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
